author: Yffe
content: FIXED (cf48c893 + 87a07885 pin ceremony). byteview_string_operand (lower.rs::lower_spec_arg) now covers the WHOLE bytes_eq String-operand class: bare path (ins), and-path (and ins), String-FIELD access (result.text), and and-field (and result.text / and b.text) all lower to <expr>.data@ (the field arm keyed on ctx.is_string_field). Without it a field operand emitted and-result.text (a and-TString) against bytes_eq's Seq<u8> params (E0308). Grounded: conformance/bytes_eq_demo.th gains buf_prefix_pin(b: Buf) over a Buf { text: String } ADT certifying L3 (forge check buf_prefix_pin L3; whole module 18 verified 0 errors). Full workspace 967 passed 0 failed, no regression. #276 Arc-2 can re-dispatch.
